basic_info.description: Located in San Francisco's desirable Potrero Hill neighborhood, 813-817 Kansas Street presents a unique opportunity to own a well-maintained, income-generating property. This charming 5-unit building offers solid in-place cash flow, featuring a unit mix of three one-bedrooms, one two-bedroom unit, and one four-bedroom, two-bathroom unit. Three of the units have been recently upgraded, and the top unit boasts stunning city views. The property also includes two individual garages and a delightful rear patio. The building underwent a significant electrical upgrade in 2024, including the installation of new sub-panels and main panels,  as well as the removal of knob-and-tube wiring in some units - please refer to the invoice in the  disclosures for detailed information. Additionally, the property has been earthquake retrofitted, ensuring enhanced structural stability. Currently, all units are tenant-occupied, offering the opportunity to acquire a stabilized asset with strong rental income. This property enjoys a vibrant neighborhood known for its sunny weather, welcoming community, and excellent connectivity. Residents benefit from quick access to Highways 101 and 280 for seamless commutes to downtown San Francisco, the Peninsula, and beyond.
